candidates.researchQuestion: What must an agent runtime know before it may treat a syntactically valid user-role response as an accountable human approval?
candidates.title: A User-Role Reply Is Not Yet a Human Approval
candidates.title_zh: “用户角色”响应不等于真人审批
candidates.coreProposition: Agent runtimes should qualify receiver-controlled origin provenance before treating user-role content as accountable human approval; positive human authentication and authorization remain separate gates.

sections.heading: role=user answers the wrong question
sections.heading_zh: role=user 回答不了谁有权批准

sections.heading: Provenance qualification should happen before approval matching
sections.heading_zh: 来源资格应先于确认内容匹配

sections.heading: An approval record needs more than a message
sections.heading_zh: 一次可追责审批需要比一条消息更多的身份

sections.heading: The negative gate does not authenticate the positive channel
sections.heading_zh: 负向门禁不能反推出正向真人已经可信

evidenceClaims.claim: The merged ADK change always marks A2A-originated invocations with receiver-owned a2a_metadata, including requests whose peer metadata is empty or absent.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 已合并的 ADK 变更会始终以接收端写入的 a2a_metadata 标记 A2A 来源 Invocation，即使对端 Metadata 为空或缺失也不会丢失该来源标记。

evidenceClaims.claim: The changed confirmation processor returns before confirmation-event resolution when the A2A marker is present.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 当 A2A Marker 存在时，变更后的确认处理器会在解析确认事件之前返回。

evidenceClaims.claim: Regression coverage includes both metadata-present and no-metadata A2A requests.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 回归测试同时覆盖带 Metadata 与无 Metadata 的 A2A 请求。

evidenceClaims.claim: The demonstrated mechanism does not authenticate the eventual human approver, establish cryptographic provenance, or prove coverage of every transport and confirmation processor.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 已证明的机制不会认证最终真人审批者身份，不建立密码学来源证明，也未证明覆盖所有 Transport 与确认处理器。

evidenceClaims.claim: Content role and accountable approval authority are different dimensions.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: Content Role 与可追责审批权是不同维度。

projectRelevance.rationale: The conclusion concerns a general approval-provenance boundary for agent systems.

communityEdition.rationale: The Research Center edition already addresses the transferable trust-boundary question and a separate community version would not add enough distinct value.

candidates.researchQuestion: Why is durable storage insufficient to guarantee that persisted agent work will be noticed and resumed by a live runtime?
candidates.title: Persistence Is Not a Wake-Up Mechanism
candidates.title_zh: 持久化不等于唤醒机制
candidates.coreProposition: Durable agent work should separate persistence from reconciliation: stored state needs external-change detection, durable object-level change identity, lifecycle reconciliation and isolated retry ownership before a live runtime can reliably rediscover and attempt progress.

sections.heading: Durable state can remain dormant
sections.heading_zh: 持久状态仍然可能长期休眠

sections.heading: Reconciliation also has a lifecycle problem
sections.heading_zh: Reconciliation 还有一个生命周期入口

sections.heading: Reconciliation is not exclusive execution
sections.heading_zh: Reconciliation 不是排他执行证明

evidenceClaims.claim: The merged implementation uses SQLite PRAGMA data_version as a coarse detector for writes committed through another connection.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 已合并实现使用 SQLite PRAGMA data_version 作为发现其他连接已提交写入的粗粒度检测器。

evidenceClaims.claim: Durable per-thread revisions identify which loaded queues changed and are updated across insert, update and delete with migration backfill.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 持久化 Per-thread Revision 用于识别哪些已加载 Queue 发生变化，并在 Insert、Update、Delete 时更新且在迁移时回填。

evidenceClaims.claim: Newly created or resumed threads are reconciled separately from the global database-change signal.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 新创建或恢复的 Thread 会独立于全局数据库变化信号进行 Reconcile。

evidenceClaims.claim: Separate per-thread watcher tasks retry unresolved wakeups on a fixed 10-second interval so one blocked thread does not serialize unrelated watcher progress.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 独立的 Per-thread Watcher Task 会以固定 10 秒间隔重试未解决的 Wakeup，使一个阻塞 Thread 不会串行阻塞其他 Watcher 进度。

evidenceClaims.claim: The change does not claim distributed exactly-once delivery, consensus, global ordering across queues or crash-proof duplicate suppression.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 该变更没有声称分布式 Exactly-once Delivery、Consensus、跨 Queue Global Ordering 或 Crash-proof Duplicate Suppression。

evidenceClaims.claim: Persistence and liveness are separate responsibilities; a live runtime still requires reconciliation to rediscover actionable durable state.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: Persistence 与 Liveness 是不同责任；活跃 Runtime 仍需要 Reconciliation 去重新发现可执行的持久状态。

projectRelevance.rationale: The conclusion concerns general durable-work reconciliation architecture.

communityEdition.rationale: The complete technical analysis already provides the reusable persistence/reconciliation distinction for the intended engineering audience.

candidates.researchQuestion: What can a request trace prove when it covers queue receipt through a terminal operational outcome, and what evidence must remain separate for external effects?
candidates.title: A Closed Trace Is Not an Effect Receipt
candidates.title_zh: Trace 已收口，不等于外部 Effect 已确定
candidates.coreProposition: Agent runtimes should model request-lifecycle telemetry and external-effect certainty as separate evidence planes linked by stable correlation identity; a terminal request outcome explains the instrumented path but does not by itself prove the state of the external effect.

sections.heading: Tracing from queue receipt closes an important blind spot
sections.heading_zh: 从 Queue Receipt 开始追踪，补上了重要盲区

sections.heading: Terminal telemetry says what happened to the instrumented path
sections.heading_zh: Terminal Telemetry 说明的是请求路径发生了什么

sections.heading: External effects need their own authoritative identity
sections.heading_zh: 外部 Effect 需要自己的权威身份

sections.heading: Better telemetry does not create stronger guarantees by itself
sections.heading_zh: 更好的 Telemetry 不会自动产生更强保证

evidenceClaims.claim: The merged exec-server change creates the inbound request span and queue timestamp at connection-queue receipt before dispatcher admission.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 已合并的 Exec-server 变更会在 Dispatcher Admission 之前、Connection Queue 收到请求时创建 Inbound Request Span 与排队时间戳。

evidenceClaims.claim: Validated optional W3C parent context is attached to that span and the same span is carried through server/client queues and route execution.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 经过验证的可选 W3C Parent Context 会附着到该 Span，同一 Span 随后贯穿 Server/Client Queue 与 Route Execution。

evidenceClaims.claim: Queue duration is emitted only after admission and uses a bounded route label.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: Queue Duration 仅在 Admission 之后记录，并使用有界 Route Label。

evidenceClaims.claim: Terminal operational outcomes such as success, error or disconnected are written to the request span.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: Success、Error、Disconnected 等 Terminal Operational Outcome 会写入 Request Span。

evidenceClaims.claim: The demonstrated trace does not establish whether an external side effect occurred before a disconnect, nor complete causal tracing, authentication, exactly-once behavior or exporter retention.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 已演示 Trace 无法建立 Disconnect 前外部副作用是否已经发生，也不建立完整 Causal Tracing、Authentication、Exactly-once Behavior 或 Exporter Retention。

evidenceClaims.claim: A closed request span is evidence of a telemetry terminal state, not an effect receipt proving the external operation reached the same state.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 关闭的 Request Span 只能证明 Telemetry Terminal State，不是证明外部操作达到同一状态的 Effect Receipt。

projectRelevance.rationale: The conclusion concerns a general observability/effect-evidence boundary for agent runtimes.

communityEdition.rationale: The Research Center edition already provides a complete and distinct engineering argument for the target audience.
